description: Add a document to a notebook: plain text, or a small file (PDF, Word, text, audio) as base64, up to 10 MB. It is processed in the background (audio is transcribed); list_knowledge_documents shows when it is ready. The same file twice is recognised. A recording or a file on the user's computer goes with create_knowledge_upload instead, so the bytes never pass through the conversation.

app_id.description: Optional app whose notebooks to use. Omitted: the owner's own Business Brain.

name: add_knowledge_document
title: Add Knowledge Document
